DELIVERABLES (all new/edited files; only these touched):
1) app/globals.css — appended near the existing reduced-motion blocks: `@keyframes dance-marquee` (translateX 0 -> -50%), `.dance-marquee-wrap` (overflow hidden; `:hover`/`:focus-within` set `.dance-marquee-track` animation-play-state paused), `.dance-marquee-track` (flex, align-items center, width max-content, animation dance-marquee 30s linear infinite, will-change transform), and `@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .dance-marquee-track { animation: none; } }`. The track duplicates the org list ([...orgs, ...orgs]) so -50% loops seamlessly.
2) features/dance/components/OrgTextPill.tsx — pure presentational (no 'use client'); `export function OrgTextPill({ name }: { name: string })` returning a span with classes `inline-flex shrink-0 items-center whitespace-nowrap rounded-full border border-border bg-muted/30 px-4 py-2 text-xs font-semibold text-muted-foreground` (matches OrgLogoBar pill tokens).
3) features/dance/components/OrgLogoCarouselClient.tsx — 'use client'. Props `{ orgs: DanceOrg[] }` (DanceOrg from '@/lib/dance/types'). Returns null when orgs is empty. Duplicates orgs for a seamless loop. Each logo in `<a href={website_url} target='_blank' rel='noopener noreferrer' aria-label={...} className='mx-4 inline-flex shrink-0 items-center' style={{height:48}}>`; next/image `<Image src alt height={40} width={140} preload={false} style={{width:'auto',height:40,objectFit:'contain'}} className='grayscale opacity-50 transition-all duration-300 hover:grayscale-0 hover:opacity-100' onError={...}>` (local /logos path, so no unoptimized/remotePattern needed). Text-pill fallback (OrgTextPill) when `logo_url`/`logo_verified` absent OR the image errors (tracked via useState Set of failed slugs). Pointer-drag swipe on the wrap: onPointerDown pauses the track + records startX; onPointerMove applies translateX(delta); onPointerUp/onPointerLeave resumes + clears offset; all drag handlers short-circuit under `window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)')`. IMPL NOTE: the drag uses `track.style.setProperty('transform', translateX(delta), 'important')` rather than a plain `style.transform` because a PAUSED CSS animation's transform sits above normal-origin inline styles in the cascade, so a plain inline transform would not visually override it; `!important` (author-important origin, above the animation origin) makes the brief's 'translateX(delta) added on top of the animation' actually take effect. On release, `removeProperty('transform')` + clearing `animationPlayState` lets the paused animation resume from its frozen frame (no jump). This is a runtime-correctness fix, not a behavior change.
